terra.problem: Saying nobody laid a finger on Job adds a detail the passage does not give.
Bildad’s preceding speech is outside this passage and needs a reference.
Saying Job takes Bildad’s picture attributes a connection to Job that the text does not state.
Job says his paths are veiled with darkness, not that he cannot see where to step.
The explanation adds a siege ramp’s purpose, which the passage does not give, and incorrectly says a tent has no walls.
Job says the ramp is built against him and the troops camp around his tent. He does not say the ramp is built against the tent.
The passage does not say Job is sitting in the tent.
The passage says Job’s kinsmen have failed him and his friends have forgotten him. It does not say everyone who should be near is gone.
Saying family and friends have both gone quiet adds a detail the passage does not give.
The passage does not say Job’s guests and maidservants live in his house.
The explanation adds that Job used to give orders and is no longer giving commands.
The explanation calls the boys the youngest in town and asserts how their behavior must feel to Job. Neither detail is given in the passage.
Saying one would expect elders to be hard on a man puts down a group based on age.
The explanation states why Job says “even,” but the passage does not give his reason.
The comparison says Job has run out of other ways to ask, which the passage does not establish.
The claim that Job’s friends have already given him plenty of advice relies on material outside this passage and needs a reference.
The passage does not say stone is the hardest or longest-lasting writing Job can think of.
The explanation treats the destruction of Job’s skin as something that has already happened, rather than keeping his statement’s timing open.
Job says he will see God; the explanation instead calls God the thing Job hopes for.
The claim that Job turns his friends’ warnings around on them relies on their earlier speeches and needs a reference.
Saying Job can finally say something back suggests he has not previously answered his friends.
